description: This file defines the DataRegistrationUtility class, which handles registration data collection, formatting, and sending for the OrangeHRM system during installation or upgrade processes. It interacts with system configuration, registration services, and system checks to facilitate registration workflows.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: Utility class for managing registration data during installation or upgrade processes, including data collection, formatting, and communication with external registration services.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Collects initial registration data from system configuration and generates an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves registration data from session/state during installation.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Returns formatted registration data payload, choosing between initial or installer data based on the presence of a unique identifier.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares registration data indicating successful registration.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique system instance identifier.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to external service and records the event.
